notes.title: Demo Patch Notes (0.5.1)
notes.notes:
[h2]Features[/h2]
[list]
[*]Checkpoint: Estate now has simple grass outdoors
[*]Most of the zombies have lost their hats
[/list]

[h2]Adjustements[/h2]
[list]
[*]Sliding now moves camera lower
[*]Adjusted normal maps in some materials
[*]Falling out-of-map position reset now works more reliably
[*]Optimized enemy rendering
[/list]

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed balcony door missing collider (e.g. grenades passed through)
[*]Fixed jumping on top of Exfiltration barrel sometimes working
[*]Fixed "remaining enemies" text appearing during Exfiltration
[*]Fixed Random Box revealing weapon too soon
[*]Fixed aim down sights not getting disabled when upgrading weapon
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44717642/6f91a275224fee57b37b0a18bf117f7313e677ad.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Demo Patch Notes (0.5.0)
notes.notes:
[h2]Features[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Added support for Sight Attachments[/b]
[list]
[*]Currently only Red Dot Sight is supported and selected
[*]Choosing own attachment loadout is coming later
[/list]
[*]Added Feedback button to main menu - please tell us what you think about the game!
[/list]

[h2]Adjustements[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Removed forced exfiltration at round 15[/b]
[list]
[*]Mid and end game content is still locked, but you can now try for a high score!
[/list]
[*]Camera now fades in from black on spawn
[*]"Enemies remaining" text is now hidden until all enemies for the current round have spawned
[*]Muzzle flash is now smaller when aiming down sights
[*]Muzzle flash is now synced to other players
[*]Added small blue light to all wall buys
[*]Movement is now blocked for downed players when they're being revived
[*]Optimized some one time operations
[*]Upgrading gun now plays pickup animation
[/list]

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed settings applying with a slight delay
[*]Fixed TEC-9 muzzle flash position
[*]Fixed other player's bullet trail spawning in player's hands
[*]Fixed boxy shadows glitch in muzzle flash
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Patch Notes (0.4.6)
notes.notes:
[h2]Features[/h2]
[list]
[*]Force is now applied to the correct bodypart of the enemy when killed with a gun
[*]More powerful guns now apply more force to dead enemies
[*]Settings page is now scrollable
[*]Added inverted mouse settings
[/list]

[h2]Adjustements[/h2]
[list]
[*]Tightened shooting animations
[*]Lowered SKS Wall Buy interaction range in Checkpoint: Estate to avoid accidental buys
[/list]

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed M4A1 sight ring lighting being inverted (flipped normals)
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Patch Notes (0.4.5)
notes.notes:
Hello!

Now that Steam Next Fest has ended we have moved the development focus back into making and adding planned content and features for the Early Access release.
We will still be updating the demo every now and then with features and bug fixes.

[h2]Features[/h2]
[list]
[*]Zombies now fall when killed according to player's position
[*]Interactions can now have different priorities
[/list]

[h2]Adjustements[/h2]
[list]
[*]Lowered player spawnpoints in Checkpoint: Estate
[*]Lowered Barricade repair priority, so that e.g. picking up a Drop is always preferred
[/list]

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed melee attacks breaking controls
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Patch Notes (0.4.3)
notes.notes:
Hello!

We have made some more adjustements to the map based on your feedback.

[h2]Features[/h2]
No new features in this update.

[h2]Adjustements[/h2]
[list]
[*]Checkpoint: Estate
[list]
[*]Decoupled outside barriers - affect map layout yourself!
[*]Added bullet penetration to barriers
[*]Removed second balcony drop position
[*]Disabled Brick Wall spawn
[*]Changed Upgrade Room outside door to metal and removed penetration
[/list]
[*]Exfiltration
[list]
[*]Added description
[*]Activating Exfiltration requires holding interaction button for 1s
[*]Players over 1 add 25 to kill requirement per player
[/list]
[*]Locked map images are now unblurred
[*]Added player profile picture placeholder
[/list]

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed many bugs related to getting downed/revived
[*]Fixed player health not immediately updating after getting revived
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Patch Notes (0.4.2)
notes.notes:
[h2]Features[/h2]
[list]
[*]Added FOV slider to Settings (duh!)
[/list]

[h2]Adjustements[/h2]
[list]
[*]Lowered Exfiltration kill requirement 100 -> 50
[*]Increased RPG-7 explosion range
[*]More enemies spawn at minimum when 3+ players are in a match
[/list]

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed AoE damage not getting applied sometimes (RPG-7, Plasma Revolver and grenades)
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Patch Notes (0.4.1)
notes.notes:
Hello!

We have released an update to our Next Fest Demo based on your feedback.
Let us know what else we should improve!

[h2]Features[/h2]
[list]
[*]Random Perk Machine now also shows the next Perk
[*]Added ability to directly select weapon slots by pressing 1-3 numbers
[*]Drops now blink with two-tiered speeds and give out an audible cue
[/list]

[h2]Adjustements[/h2]
[list]
[*]Checkpoint: Estate building now has a foundation and interior is now slightly elevated
[*]Exfiltration is now locked until round 10, but doesn't cost anything
[*]Reduced zombie head hitbox width - headshots now require more skill!
[*]Notification background is now darker
[*]Lowered M16 audio volume
[*]Changed Sawed-off shooting sound
[*]Updated Map images to higher quality ones
[/list]

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed vote skip not working in co-op
[*]Fixed bleeding out message staying after getting revived
[*]Fixed MOAB giving points for already dead enemies
[*]Fixed out-of-map exploits in Checkpoint: Estate
[*]Fixed perk machine light position
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44717642/9e4f370f95ff9366fdc716d9c1648c71076e8380.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Demo Patch Notes (0.3.3)
notes.notes:

[list]
[*]Added self revive
[list]
[*]Buying and upgrading Medic Perk gives more self revives

[list]

[*]M4A1: Increased sight ring size for better visibility
[*]Updated Main Menu disclaimer
[*]Adjusted secret notification texts
[*]Optimized Random Box VFX activation
[/list]

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed co-op revive bug where downed player would be reset sometimes
[*]Fixed co-op revive bug where reviver could continue reviving player after getting downed themselves
[/list]
